<translate>
'''Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament''' is the easiest tournament, a one-star '''gauntlet''' held at Baba's Palace on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. You beat Baba's four fighters one after another, then the Masked Warrior and finally '''Kid Goku'''. Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting there ==

The tournament is hosted by [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Palace|Baba's Palace]], a structure that generates in the oceans of the Overworld. Every [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] of tier 3 or higher sells a map to Baba's Palace for 6 Glass Bottles. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].

Talk to Baba, press '''Tournament''' and then '''Enter''' while you are within 12 blocks of her. Like every tournament arena, Baba's Palace can't be built in or broken by survival players (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments#Arena protection|arena protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Format ==

This tournament is a '''gauntlet''': you fight every contender from left to right, then the semi-finalist and the champion. With a party, the members share one ladder and take the ring in turns; if the current fighter loses, another member steps in against the same opponent, and when the champion falls every member who accepted the rules gets the rewards.

Each bout lasts up to '''5 minutes'''; a bout that runs out of time is void and fought again. The general rules for entering and bouts are on [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighters ==

The four contenders come in random order and get 10% stronger for every round already played. The stats below are the defaults for the first round.

<translate>
== Rewards ==

Beating Kid Goku wins '''10,000 TP''' and '''+5 alignment''', with fireworks and the victory music. Losing a bout, withdrawing or being disqualified puts you on a '''20-minute''' cooldown before you can enter again; winning starts the same cooldown.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==

The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] also pits you against Fortuneteller Baba's fighters as story quests.
</translate>
